description: This file contains integration tests for loan charge waiver functionality within the Apache Fineract project. It tests scenarios such as waiving charges, scheduled repayments, and interactions with loan lifecycle events.

classes.name: LoanWaiveChargeTest
classes.description: A test class extending BaseLoanIntegrationTest, designed to verify the behavior of waiving loan charges and related scenarios in the system.

methods.name: processingStrategy
methods.description: Provides different payment processing strategies to parameterize tests.

methods.name: test_LoanPaidByDateIsCorrect_WhenNPlusOneInstallmentCharge_IsWaived
methods.description: Tests that the loan's paid-by date remains correct after waiving charges on a specific installment.

methods.name: accrualIsCalculatedWhenThereIsWaivedChargeAndLoanIsClosed
methods.description: Verifies accrual calculations when charges are waived and the loan is subsequently closed.

methods.name: testLoanCannotBeChargedOffWhenUndoingFeeWaiver
methods.description: Ensures that the system prevents charging off a loan when a fee waiver is undone.
